editions.title: September 2, 2026
editions.dek: A record 3.46 billion pound Premier League window closed with Enzo Fernandez joining Manchester City for 125m and two agreed deals collapsing after the buzzer.

editions.title: September 1, 2026
editions.dek: Arsenal close the window having sold Gabriel Jesus and Gabriel Martinelli, missed out on Malick Fofana and loaned Ethan Nwaneri to Dortmund, all while unbeaten and yet to concede.

editions.title: August 31, 2026
editions.dek: Labor Day weekend opens a five-week run that ends with Hardly Strictly free in the park, plus Portola, Folsom and the Giants' last homestand.

editions.title: August 26, 2026
editions.dek: Six days from the September 1 deadline, a World Cup summer has pushed Europe

editions.title: August 25, 2026
editions.dek: Arsenal open the title defence with two 3-0 wins and six days left to remake a forward line, with Gabriel Martinelli close to a record Saudi exit.

editions.title: August 19, 2026
editions.dek: Europe restarts 33 days after the World Cup with ten new Premier League managers, Rodri sold to Barcelona and Pep Guardiola gone after a decade.

editions.title: August 18, 2026
editions.dek: Arsenal begin their Premier League title defence against Coventry on Friday, three days after a 3-0 Community Shield win and with the centre-back department still unfixed.

editions.title: August 17, 2026
editions.dek: Outside Lands packed up ten days ago and Stern Grove closed with Al Green yesterday afternoon.
